comments.body: Security reviewed as confidentiality risk; prioritize before the next enterprise review.

content.text: Security reviewed as confidentiality risk; prioritize before the next enterprise review.
Support search returns tickets belonging to other workspaces when those workspaces share an email domain with the searching agent tenant.
Workspace isolation should scope search hits by workspace id regardless of shared domains on example.com customer contacts.
Tighten the search filter, add multi-workspace isolation tests, and audit recent cross-workspace search access logs.
